description.value: Cranbrook's main arena and recreation complex, home to the Cranbrook Bucks junior hockey team. The facility houses a swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, and ice rinks — appealing for a touring cyclist looking to recover after a long ride through the East Kootenay. Located just north of downtown Cranbrook with bus service on multiple routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Western Financial Place is Cranbrook's main arena and recreation complex, with a swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, ice rinks, concessions, and event hosting. The Plan Your Visit page documents drinking fountains in the main lobby (water refill) and extensive accessible washrooms. Concessions and a full-service restaurant are confirmed on site. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, showers available outside of pool admission, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. OSM tags for swimming_pool, hot_tub, sauna, and ice_rink are corroborated by website content.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website shows two different numbers — 250-489-0220 on contact page and 250-489-0267 in footer (the latter appears to be the administration/lost-and-found line)
Concessions and restaurant may only operate during events and hockey games, not daily
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A major public recreation complex with pool, hot tub, and sauna that a touring cyclist would value for recovery. Also offers water, washrooms, and food on site. Clearly operational and well-documented.
enrichment_extras.notes: 953-stall parking lot but no mention of any bicycle parking. Pool and recreation facilities likely require admission. Bus routes #12 and #20 serve the venue directly.
